Idle and move use a stable two-hand ready carry; attack is shoulder, aim, fire, recoil and recovery; reload visibly removes the old magazine, retrieves and seats one replacement, operates the action and returns to ready; death is an irreversible supported collapse with the weapon retained in the composition and optional restrained white synthetic fluid, never red blood. No Working Joe skin or work uniform, human Marine face, giant mecha, powered exoskeleton, superhero armor, official logo, iconic pulse-rifle copy, weapon redesign, extra limb, disappearing weapon, left-facing pose, copied official bitmap or 1:1 claim.
